changes: Client rendering omits deleted messages from the DOM while retaining all tombstones, sequence numbers, cursors and deletion-wins merge state.
Client notifications targeting a deleted message focus history and consume their navigation reference without a tombstone or deleted-message notice.
Delete-message controls and the frontend delete handler are admin-only; existing sender ownership and confirmation remain unchanged.

No visible per-message ellipsis remains, including selected text, photos and videos. Ordinary bubble/caption clicks reveal metadata; photo/video interactive controls keep their own behavior. A native Details button is revealed only for keyboard focus.
Emoji panel has no search field. Categories, skin tones, cursor insertion, translation, keyboard navigation and owner checks remain. Opening focuses Close rather than an input.

Touch-capable devices use any-pointer:coarse to dismiss the composer keyboard and avoid automatic text-field focus after send, profile load/save, emoji/quick-reply insertion, photo/video selection and removal. Desktop focus behavior is preserved.
Client download moved into Options > More options, with help/contact. Closing the menu collapses its secondary options.
Admin chat has a single Admin home link to /admin; removed legacy raw tool links and their task-summary/broadcast menu polling. Tasks capability remains available to the CRM UI.
Opening notification settings refreshes their existing mounted panel and closes the options menu.
